results.title: credit_balances.balance_total equals the signed sum of its ledger entries
credit_balances.balance_held equals the sum of HOLDs nothing has settled
held never exceeds total, and neither is negative
every settling entry points at a HOLD in the same workspace
a settling DEBIT never charges more than the HOLD it settles
only ADJUST carries a non-positive amount, and ADJUST is never zero
balance_after on every entry equals available (total − held) as of that entry
no workspace has ledger entries but no balance row
